text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! A Paka Puchi, right here in my arms...!
Tsuyoshi is so touched!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's pretty fluffy, isn't it?
No wonder the crane arm keeps slipping~"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, totally! It's burned into my memory!
You move it with a *whirrr*—and then a quick *flick*!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Drop the claw so it hooks right into the indentation!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can totally do this! Next up, leave it to me!
Big sis is gonna grab one for yaaa!!
